written: 2026-11-12, committed before the held-step probe of #266 (after the coordinator's question: the held step at 640x480 measured 4.6 to 7.6 times the merged head's on Actions)
phase: camera lane PR 2 (#266), the held step's cost across the fix round
labels: the builder's predictions; basis: the Actions run 43169707692 (merged head, held 640x480 f32 0.17 ms on an EPYC 9V74), run 43283574940 (pushed code, 0.78 ms on an EPYC 9V74), and a local A/B on one shared laptop (the node before and after the cache change: 0.91 against 0.93 and 1.21 ms; not a timing claim)
seen_before: run 43169707692 and run 43283574940's costs; the local A/B above. The cause is NOT known: the guess that the comparison or the extra carried array moved the cost is unchecked, and the local A/B does not support it. The guess that the runner varies is also unchecked: this probe is the test of both.

operating_point.platform: one GitHub runner, 4 vCPU, one CPU pinned, one thread, the three commits' trees side by side in one job
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: the done case's scene, 320x240 and 640x480; held step (a frame every 100000 steps) and frame step (a frame every step), the camera in the world; three rounds, the order of the sides rotating, each process the minimum of 8 repeats

gate_held_step.claim: the held step of the pushed head is within noise of the held step before the fix round and of the merged head's, on the same CPU, at every size and dtype

prediction.unit: head / before, the median over three rounds of each program's min ms per step
prediction.why: the change adds a few dozen numbers to the state and a comparison that a held step does not execute (the held step takes the `keep` branch); a ratio outside the band is the cause to find

gate_held_step.metric: the head's held-step time over each other side's, per program, per round: the rounds' spread says the noise

control.plant: none: the comparison is between commits; the rounds' spread (the same program on the same side in three rounds) is the noise floor it is judged against
control.resolution: a ratio is read only if it exceeds the largest spread of one side's rounds

gate_held_step.if_wrong: the cause is in the change (a copy of the cache through the cond's operands, or the extra state array): find it, fix it, re-run this probe
gate_held_step.cannot_discriminate_if: the three sides' held steps disagree among themselves across rounds by more than the band (the runner varies within a job)

gate_frame_step.claim: the frame step is within the same band

prediction.why: the frame step makes the same renders; the cond over a stale flag adds a predicate

outcomes.probe: https://github.com/Microrobotics-Simulation-Framework/MIME/actions/runs/43293161434 (first launch 43292758333 failed: a short hash in a shallow checkout; probe branch deleted)
